thesis: The speaker argues that institutional allocators typically rely on a traditional asset class framework, such as a 60/40 split, which can be misleading because it obscures the underlying drivers of returns and risk. He suggests that a factor-based lens is necessary to answer questions that this traditional view cannot, particularly regarding the specific sources of risk and return within those broad categories.
